scope: First certified full free-reply protocol on the DG-020/021/022 panel: real per-token free generation through the diagnostic uncertainty controller and through the plain base path, with dual isolated blind review. Zero optimizer steps, no checkpoint, no serving, no LoCoMo. Wrong routing of normal/supported records is preserved as real failure, not masked.
generation: Per record: fresh controller under DG-023 identity; position-0 frame from the frozen continuous probe at the natural prompt. At every position the model's OWN committed tokens extend the actual prefix; each frame is a fresh full-prefix C forward with zero residual (no KV reuse across positions, disclosed single-prefill internal K/V buffers). Reply budget 24 tokens, capacity 128; stop on EOS, budget or UTF-8 failure; truncation recorded, never trimmed. Untrained branch is expected to equal base greedy token-for-token; per-position bitwise zero-residual parity and decision==argmax(C logits) are hard gates.
base_arm: For all normal and supported records also run the plain base greedy loop (no wrapper, no branch) at the same prompts. The untrained-branch reply must be byte-identical to the base reply; any divergence is a protocol failure, not a reviewer question.
review: Blind packets contain id, language, question text, reply text and truncation flag only - no gold answers, labels, routes, model names or scores. Two isolated reviewer instances of the same model family (disclosed as such, not human or cross-family calibration) each adjudicate every packet with the pre-registered schema: claims[] (subject/relation/value as stated), acknowledges_missing_evidence, natural_reply, unsolicited_memory_narration. Full denominators; disagreements and needs_review are recorded, never dropped.

gates.protocol: 12/12 replies generated with all positions C-verified; zero-update digests unchanged; branch-vs-base byte identity on normal+supported records
gates.semantic_pre_registered_expectation: uncertainty items pass iff acknowledges_missing_evidence and no unevidenced claim about the asked fact; normal items pass iff arithmetically correct natural answer without memory narration; supported items pass iff correct subject+value grounded answer. The untrained model is EXPECTED to fail most semantic gates; this round certifies the protocol and records the honest starting point, it does not claim memory ability.
gates.stopping: No threshold relaxation after seeing replies; no example removal; no re-review after disagreement except recording both labels

limits: Reviewers are same-family isolated contexts. Replies at zero-init are base continuations; passing natural_reply on some items is not refusal competence. No training budget is requested or consumed; CG-003's 100 steps remain exhausted.
stop: Keep every reply including truncated, wrong-subject or fabricated ones. Do not use review outcomes to select weights or to start training; a new budget must be separately registered and approved. V2 remains incomplete; no HTTP, no LoCoMo, no deployment.
